exposure: Pre-eclampsia (PE) with or without foetal growth restriction (FGR)
Timing of delivery (before/after 34 weeks of gestation)
outcome: Extracellular Hsp mRNA levels (Hsp27, Hsp60, Hsp70, Hsp90, Hsp70 binding protein 1 (HspBP1) mRNAs)
cohort: The study included pregnancies with gestational hypertension (n=33), pre-eclampsia with or without foetal growth restriction (n=78), and foetal growth restriction (n=25).
finding: Upregulation of Hsp70 was observed in patients with mild and severe pre-eclampsia, and in pregnancies complicated with pre-eclampsia delivering before and after 34 weeks of gestation, reflecting maternal and placental stress response.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, for women experiencing gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, or foetal growth restriction.
gest_age: Delivery before and after 34 weeks of gestation was used as a characteristic to analyze Hsp gene expression in PE.
